items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: We had just come from a fight. We went to see Joe Louis fight in Madison Square Garden.

ctx.x: Actually aiming too high. He wanted to be on a level with Duke Ellington, Cab Calloway, and he didn't have the talent to do that. He used to go down to the

Cotton Club, you know, and be seen around there, and talking and whatever. You know. So one night -- one night my wife and I, we were downtown. We had just come from a fight. We went to see Joe Louis fight in Madison Square Garden. He fought a fellow named Nathan Mann who he knocked out in the second or third round or something like that. So I -- so we walked down, you know, walking down the street, and we got to 52nd Street. So then when we got to 52nd Street where Kirby was working at the Onyx Club. So I said…
"No, you go in," she said. "I think I'll go home." I remember distinctly, you know. So she says, "Oh, yes, Kirby's in there." So she said, "Well, you go ahead. I'm going home."
